name: atom-audit-fleet
description: Audit every atom in parallel against the component guidelines, one worker per small group, merging rows into one ATOM_AUDIT.md table (orchestrator-workers variant of atom-audit). Use when the atom count is 6 or more and COMPONENT_GUIDELINES.md exists. Do not use below 6 atoms (use atom-audit single-agent), without COMPONENT_GUIDELINES.md, or when only 1 or 2 atoms changed (use design-spec-review per component).
